whyWeExist.headline: Why We Exist
content: Startups don't need "more features"; they need a system that turns ideas into durable products fast.
Big agencies over-index on decks; freelancers burn time on rewrites.
We bring senior-led pods that make technical decisions once, implement them right, and measure business impact.
